standard-dialogue.npc: Human agreed to sacrifice [himself/herself] to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-him-before-.npc: Puny human show respect to Zulrah or I smash you head.

steps.npc: Zulrah the great god. He mighty. You go see High Priestess, she tell you lots and lots.

standard-dialogue-using-the-zul-andra-de.npc: You leave that alone, human. You not one of us.
